anomalies.observed: U2 is specified as ATtiny13V-10S but uses footprint Package_SO:SOIC-8W_5.3x5.3mm_P1.27mm.
anomalies.expected: ATtiny13V-10S is an 8-pin narrow-body SOIC (0.150"/3.9mm width); it should use Package_SO:SOIC-8_3.9x4.9mm_P1.27mm.
anomalies.impact: The SOIC-8W footprint is wider than the ATtiny13V-10S package, so the part will not fit or solder correctly on the board.

anomalies.observed: C1 is 100nF and is connected between the +5V rail (U3 output) and GND.
anomalies.expected: The LM1117-5.0 datasheet requires an output capacitor of at least 10µF for stability.
anomalies.impact: The 5V rail may be unstable or oscillate, potentially causing the ATtiny microcontrollers to malfunction or reset.

anomalies.observed: Two ATtiny microcontrollers (U2: ATtiny13V-10S and U4: ATtiny45-20P) are connected pin-to-pin on all I/O, reset, and power nets.
anomalies.expected: Only one ATtiny should be populated; the other should be removed or marked DNP.
anomalies.impact: If both are populated, they will contend on shared nets, causing programming failure, I/O contention, and possible damage.

parsed.summary: The design files contain multiple anomalies: U2 has an incompatible SOIC-8W footprint for an ATtiny13V-10S, C1 is 100nF instead of the required >=10µF for the LM1117-5.0 output, and two ATtiny microcontrollers are connected in parallel on all pins, which would cause contention if both are populated.
